additional_info.body:
Dear Sadek,
We have rolled the charger to 3.2.8 but unfortunately the charger has been offline SCB after roll out.
Please let us know If charger has been successfully commissioned or not?
We have checked the charger on SCB and found that it is currently offline and last error flag was of charger door open. Has someone working on this site today?
Unfortunately, we are unable to perform any further actions remotely without an active SCB connection.
As a next step, I recommend performing a local reboot will be necessary to bring the charger back online.
If the charger remains offline after these actions, we will need to plan a site visit to inspect the router settings and check the network signal strength.
Please let us know if further assistance is required.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar

additional_info.subject: RE: 0384448 - ID0384448-DC/Si-D/SA- [MP / RD 170003182] Firmware Update CRM:02023000187
additional_info.body:
Dear Sadek,
Hope you're doing well.
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection.
The best would be to have someone on site to check:
Local reboots help to bring the charger back online.
If the router is connected to internet
And kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
data service of mobile network operator might not be available
- SIM card disabled / expired/ not inserted properly
- monthly data volume exhausted
- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger
- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
-Teltonika related issues
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash
Also refer this KA for your reference:
https://isp.crm4.dynamics.com/main.aspx?appid=582042be-d464-ed11-9562-000d3ab780dd&pagetype=entityrecord&etn=knowledgearticle&id=cc8045f4-f159-ee11-be6f-000d3aba351f
